My Big Sister Can Do Anything Dessy Natalia
This is my big sister, Risa. She can do anything. Like climb trees...
...and fly airplanes. I want to be like Risa. I want to fly airplanes, too.
Oh, no! The airplane crashes to the ground.
"I'll get it," Risa says. She's not afraid of the fierce dog.
She picks up the airplane.
"Don't worry," she tells me. "We can fix the airplane. "Then, Risa makes friends with the dog.
On our way home, Risa trips and falls.
"I'm okay," Risa says. She stands up and brushes herself off.
"Let's go home and eat," Risa says, "Then we will fix the airplane."
Mom isn't home, so Risa says she will make our special fried rice.
While Risa cooks, I try to fix the airplane. Hmmm. I wonder how to fix it.
When I ask Risa for help, I notice that she's crying!
Why is Risa crying? Is she sad? Is she hurt?
Risa can climb trees. Risa isn't afraid of fierce dogs. Risa stands up and brushes herself off when she falls.
Risa can do anything. So, why is she crying?
What's this?
Now I am crying, too!
Oh, it's the onion!
Risa's fried rice tastes so good. After lunch, we fix the airplane together. My sister can do anything.
